answer: Mirror-Comet Delta (MCD) clearing: each agent’s payout is split into a holdback and rebate. A random mirror agent replays the task; the system measures delta between claimed and mirrored outputs and checks the agent’s comet—its recent counterparty path. Low-delta agents get holdback refunded plus rebate; high-delta or path-reusing clones forfeit holdback and pay a replay surcharge. Cloning requires independent mirrored histories and low-delta performance per identity, costing more than one honest agent’s fees.
